title: Example 05: Expose capabilities
summary: A complete Todo page keeps its own assistant. The same six named operations have two consumers: an in-page console, and Codex or Claude outside the page through a local MCP bridge. Records, approvals, and business handlers stay on the page.
summaryZh: 一个完整的 Todo 页面保留自己的助手，把同一组六项具名能力交给两个消费者：页面内的控制台，以及页面外经本地 MCP 桥接入的 Codex 或 Claude。记录、审批与业务处理仍留在页面内。

guide.title: Connect a real external agent to the page
guide.titleZh: 把一个真实的外部 Agent 接到页面上
intro: The page already has a useful assistant. This example answers a different question: how can a user's own Codex or Claude operate the same page without receiving its DOM or internal store?

The agent starts from describe, chooses a named operation, then calls invoke. A local MCP server only transports those two protocol methods. The page still validates input, runs the existing business function, and asks its operator to confirm destructive work.

To try it: run pnpm dev:examples, open /external-agent-surface/?mcp=1, register mcp-server.mjs with your MCP client, then ask the agent to describe the page and add a task. The page shows a pending approval for deletion.
introZh: 页面本身已经有一个可用的助手。这个案例回答的是另一个问题：用户自己的 Codex 或 Claude，如何在不拿 DOM、内部 store 的情况下操作同一个页面？
外部 Agent 先调用 describe，选择具名操作，再调用 invoke。本地 MCP server 只负责传输这两个协议方法；参数校验、业务处理与破坏性操作的真人确认仍由页面完成。
实际操作时：运行 pnpm dev:examples，打开 /external-agent-surface/?mcp=1，在 MCP 客户端里注册 mcp-server.mjs，再让 Agent 描述页面并新增一条待办。删除会在页面上等待真人审批。

steps.title: Reuse the executor instead of writing a second one
steps.titleZh: 复用执行器，而不是另写一套执行逻辑
steps.body: The Surface receives the existing executor. Parameter checks, confirmations, expectations, and audit events therefore stay on one path.
steps.bodyZh: Surface 接收现有执行器。参数校验、确认、成功判据与审计事件因此仍走同一条路径。

steps.title: Write down the external allowlist
steps.titleZh: 明确写出对外允许清单
steps.body: Only these six capability ids are visible and callable. Everything else remains a page-internal action.
steps.bodyZh: 只有这六项能力可见、可调用；其余动作仍只属于页面内部。

steps.title: Describe business effects and parameters
steps.body: Each capability has a stable id, a description, typed parameters, and an effect. Deletion is marked danger and always requires confirmation.
steps.bodyZh: 每项能力都有稳定 id、说明、类型化参数与效果。删除标记为 danger，并且每次都要求确认。

steps.title: Publish records, not component internals
steps.titleZh: 发布记录，而不是组件内部结构
steps.body: v-record supplies stable ids and readable fields. The external client can choose a record without receiving the component's reactive state.
steps.bodyZh: v-record 提供稳定 id 与可读字段。外部客户端可以选择记录，但不会收到组件的响应式状态。

steps.title: Connect the page to a loopback bridge
steps.titleZh: 把页面接到本地回环桥
steps.body: With ?mcp=1, the page opens one WebSocket to 127.0.0.1. Incoming requests still go through surface.handle; the bridge has no DOM access and no generic click operation.
steps.bodyZh: 带 ?mcp=1 打开时，页面只连接 127.0.0.1 的一条 WebSocket。收到的请求仍经过 surface.handle；桥没有 DOM 权限，也没有通用点击能力。

steps.title: Expose those methods as MCP tools
steps.titleZh: 把这两个方法映射成 MCP 工具
steps.body: The stdio server exposes describe, invoke, and a read-only approval-status query. There is deliberately no tool that approves on the user's behalf.
steps.bodyZh: stdio server 暴露 describe、invoke 与只读的审批状态查询。它刻意没有“代用户批准”的工具。

steps.title: Register the server with the agent you already use
steps.titleZh: 在现有的 Agent 中注册这个 server
steps.body: Codex and Claude Code provide CLI commands. Hermes, Claude Desktop, WorkBuddy, and other clients take the same command and arguments in their own MCP settings; there is no shared CLI syntax to copy. The client does not need a browser extension or a vendor-specific API.
steps.bodyZh: Codex 与 Claude Code 提供命令行命令；Hermes、Claude Desktop、WorkBuddy 等客户端则在各自的 MCP 设置里填写同一组 command 与 args，并不存在一条通用的 CLI 写法。客户端不需要浏览器扩展，也不需要厂商专用 API。

steps.title: Keep destructive approval on the page
steps.titleZh: 把破坏性审批留在页面
steps.body: An external request cannot approve itself. The page operator sees the pending action, and only their decision releases the promise.
steps.bodyZh: 外部请求不能自我批准。页面操作者看到待处理动作，只有其决定才会释放执行。

steps.title: Mount the page assistant separately
steps.body: The page keeps its own chat entry. The external console is a second consumer of the same capabilities, not a replacement for the page assistant.
steps.bodyZh: 页面保留自己的对话入口。外部控制台是同一组能力的第二个消费者，不替代页面助手。

guide.note: Open this page with ?mcp=1, register mcp-server.mjs in Codex, Claude Code, Hermes, or another stdio MCP client, then ask it to describe the Todo page and add a task. Codex and Claude Code use their CLI; other clients take the same command and args in their own settings. The node command is a local stdio MCP process, not a page data file; it reaches the open page over 127.0.0.1. A hosted deployment pairs the page with a Surface Gateway and gives the agent an HTTPS MCP endpoint. A delete must wait for approval on this page.
guide.noteZh: 用 ?mcp=1 打开页面，在 Codex、Claude Code、Hermes 或其他 stdio MCP 客户端中注册 mcp-server.mjs，再让它描述 Todo 页面并新增一条待办。Codex 与 Claude Code 可用命令行，其他客户端在各自设置里填写同一组 command 与 args。node 命令是本地 stdio MCP 进程，不是页面数据文件；它通过 127.0.0.1 连接当前页面。线上部署时页面与 Surface Gateway 配对，Agent 使用 HTTPS MCP 端点。删除必须在本页等待审批。
